CodeQL query that flags duplicate magic constants in src macros.

# Purpose
This query file defines a CodeQL problem check named `No duplicate magic constant`. It searches C++ source files under `src/` for macros whose names match `MAGIC` and compares their macro bodies and fully converted expressions. When two different macros use the same magic constant value, the query reports one of them with a warning. The file is a static analysis rule, not an executable program or a library file.
